text:
olivia: Quick ask — putting together a compact 'warmstart + prefetch' playbook for low-touch trial accounts to reduce cold-start latencies and surface renewal risks. Input wanted from eng + CS.

maria: love that. can we have one-liner TL;DRs for AEs so they can set expectations? e.g., 'warmstart recommended before first large batch'.

devon: +1. also add an ops-safe warmup recipe that doesn't blow through quota. something like: 4 parallel warm requests, 2s interval, 90s keepalive.

sam: would be helpful to include an example prefetch list format — keys to prime (user_prompt_prefix, recent_history_hash, personalization_vector).

olivia: agree. thinking of three sections: 1) preflight checks (quota, model pin, region), 2) warmstart recipe, 3) runtime fallback knobs.

maria: add a quick renewal signal: >3 cold-starts in first 48h + high error rate = flag for AE. Also include how to capture feedback in-app.

devon: here's a tiny snippet we use for safe priming — shareable to customers as a paste: ```# pseudo
for key in prefetch_keys:
  client.prefetch(key)
  sleep(2)
```

sam: for batching guidance: recommend payload grouping by user-session and keep batch size <= 8 for sub-100ms token latency on typical models. mention tradeoff table.

olivia: good call. i'll draft the AE TL;DR and the 'what we monitor' checklist: cold-start count, 95p latency, error spikes, sustained qps.

maria: can we include a one-click script customers can run for a warmup? small shell + curl example. AE can paste into onboarding email.

devon: small note on streaming: if a customer uses stream=true, recommend shorter initial chunks and prefix caching to avoid re-streaming whole context on retries.

sam: capture feedback mechanism: ask customers to paste 1) an example prompt, 2) observed latency, 3) any unexpected tokens — feed that into the eval harness.

olivia: @sam @devon i'll compile contributions into a 1-page playbook + 3-step checklist. aiming for a customer-facing PDF + internal CS-runbook.

cs-bot: playbook-draft v0.1 uploaded to /shared/cs/playbooks/warmstart-prefetch-v0.1.pdf (auto). review requested.

maria: will review with AE this afternoon. :thumbsup:

devon: i'll add a small diagram for routing + cache priming.

olivia: thanks all — goal: reduce early churn and give AEs concrete steps when they see warmup failures. I'll ping once draft is ready.
